title: Obligation and permission
function: Give orders, ask permission, express prohibition

phases.name: Presentation
phases.content: In this unit you will learn how to talk about rules, permission and obligation using can, must and imperatives.

phases.name: Discovery
phases.content: Read these sentences. You can sit here. You must not smoke. Turn off your phone. Notice: can = permission, must not = prohibition, imperative = direct instruction.

phases.name: Guided practice
phases.prompt: You ___ park here. It is forbidden.

phases.name: Free practice
phases.prompt: Write 3 rules for your classroom using can, must, must not.

phases.name: Mini-test
phases.explanation: Can I ... is used to ask for permission.
